name: revised-down
about: §4R L2: Meta revised yesterday's numbers down overnight; the fold holds only the revised figures, which are smaller than the first report.

output.headline: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running on November 2, 2026, spending $110.90 for 2 leads at $55.45 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet delivered 6,015 impressions, 70 clicks at a 1.2% click rate, and 2 leads on $110.90 in spend — all figures match day totals since it was the only campaign running.
November 2026 has 29 days left; Meta spend so far this month is $198.00.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) is mature: 33 contacted, 17 converted, 10 applied, 4 hired, and 8 lost after conversion.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) is mature: 36 contacted, 20 converted, 12 applied, 5 hired, and 9 lost after conversion.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads, with 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — it is too young to judge rates.
No lead quality data was available for the 14-day window; nothing to flag on wrong numbers or missed hard requirements.
